title: MSFS Marketplace: 13 NEW Releases! Delta A220 Missions, Airline Bundles & America VFR
description:
Are you ready to step into scheduled commercial airline cockpits or take a scenic low-and-slow flight across breathtaking American landmarks in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? The Marketplace just delivered 13 brand new featured releases—headlined by dedicated Delta Air Lines A220 multi-leg missions, discounted summer airline collection bundles, massive real-world global hub traffic schedules, and a fully narrated VFR expedition across the United States!

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive into the details, aircraft compatibility, and operational features to help you decide what fits your flight routine and budget:

✈️ COMMERCIAL FLEET ROTATIONS & AIRLINE MISSIONS (DELTA A220 & A320neo BUNDLES)
Step into the cockpit for structured commercial operations. Perfect Flight brings the "12 Legs A220 DAL Fall 2026" pack featuring authentic Delta Air Lines line flights, authentic aviation audio, and monitored flight events (compatible with the Virtualcol or Synaptic A220; base aircraft required). In addition, budget-conscious line flyers get the "Summer Trans 2026 Master Collection #1," bundling previously released Breeze Airways, Air Canada, and American Airlines rotations for the iniBuilds A320neo V2 into a single discounted package.

🌐 GLOBAL AIRLINE FLEETS & INTERNATIONAL HUB OVERHAULS (VA SYSTEMS)
Looking to inject real-world airline schedules and authentic liveries into your simulator? VA Systems introduces targeted Summer 2026 schedule packages for carriers including Kuwait Airways, LOT Polish Airlines, Solomon Airlines, Thai Airways, and Volaris. In addition, major international gateway hub packs arrive for Oslo Gardermoen (ENGM), Mexico City (MMMX), Christchurch (NZCH), Muscat (OOMS), and Gimpo (RKSS)—bringing authentic departure banks, route schedules, and airline liveries to busy commercial terminals.

🏞️ SCENIC EXPEDITIONS (GUIDED TOURS: AMERICA VFR)
Transform your cockpit into a front-row seat to the most iconic national parks and geological wonders across the United States. Perfect Flight delivers "America VFR," an 8-stage guided touring expedition featuring 200 automated audio narrations in six languages and 167 detailed points of interest. Fly low and slow from the volcanic peaks of the Pacific Northwest and the Grand Canyon, across the Colorado Rockies and Yellowstone, all the way to Mount Whitney, Yosemite, and Lake Tahoe!

Whether you're managing scheduled rotations in the A220, populating busy international airports worldwide, or cruising along scenic mountain ranges in America VFR, these additions deliver structured real-world goals for your flight sessions.

Which of these releases are you loading into your flight computer first? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
